deal.name: Share My Image – Video & Image Hosting with Fast Sharing & Secure Storage
deal.tagline: Upload and share videos, Shorts, and images instantly with a clean, fast, and powerful platform.

plans.name: Single
terms: Lifetime access to Image Storage Plan
You must redeem your code within 60 days of purchase

features: Upload Images & Videos up to 1 GB
Images support types - JPG, PNG, BMP, GIF, and WEBP.
Videos support types - MOV, MP4, WebM.
ShareX integration to share screenshots and video screen recording.
Create Folders: Organize your product images efficiently by creating folders and subfolders.
Set folder privacy options: public, private, or password-protected.
Generate and Share Links After Uploading Images.
ShareMyImage.com creates various types of links: Direct links, HTML, Thumbnail, Markdown, BB Code.
Get All Image Links Easily: Retrieve album image links with a single click.
Each folder/album can generate up to 1000 links.
Help for eCommerce Businesses: Create product listings via CSV upload, saving time and effort.
Bulk image management for Amazon, eBay, Flipkart, Shopify, WooCommerce, and other platforms.
Global CDN for faster content access worldwide.
Get a personalized brand URL (e.g., ShareMyImage.com/YourBrand).
Organize and showcase your products' portfolio.
Share URL on WhatsApp, Telegram, and other platforms.

themes.summary: Many buyers say the tool works well for hosting images and videos and generating shareable links.

hits.quote: it's proven to be both useful and robust.
I've already applied it to sites and it's working flawlessly, thank you.
It’s fast, reliable, and really easy to use.
Uploads are quick, and there are a number of ways to share/embed your images.
Other than my annoyance that an API is listed but they don't allow image uploading via URLs it actually works fine.

themes.summary: Several buyers say folder navigation is confusing and sharing and bulk downloading are cumbersome or missing.

hits.quote: The folder structure is confusing and difficult to navigate, making it hard to locate or organize images.
Navigating the UI and adding folders is difficult and disorganized.
Unfortunately, the most important feature is missing, which is to bulk download images by copying and pasting a list of URLs
The UI/UX and the marketing of the product are still a bit rough on the edges

themes.summary: Several buyers say bulk uploads fail with only about half of images succeeding.

hits.quote: when uploading around 10 images at once, only half of them successfully upload.
I realized that at times half my images failed to upload.

themes.summary: Several buyers say advertised API uploads and Windows app are missing or disabled.

hits.quote: The website does show an API is available and yet upon trying with N8N i got an error stating image uploading has been disabled.
There is no Windows application available for download on the official website
